Senses.Explanation: The bowing cloth is the small monastic cloth spread or handled during formal prostrations. Damei Faying and Xuance place its unfolding inside visible greetings, and Huineng’s scene makes its handling part of the encounter’s timing. It is still a physical monastic article; the dramatic uses do not make it a symbol of submission by definition.
